name: ha-mcp
description: Configure and automate Home Assistant with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants.
one_liner: Lets you set up and control your entire smart home by just talking to Claude or ChatGPT instead of hunting through dashboards and automation menus.
buyer: A smart-home installer who wants to offer 'talk to your house' setup as a premium add-on to clients already running Home Assistant.
business_use_cases: A smart-home installer adds 'AI voice and chat control of your whole house' as a premium upsell when installing Home Assistant for residential clients.
A property manager for short-term rentals lets guests ask a chat assistant to adjust lights, thermostat, or locks instead of fumbling through an unfamiliar app.
An accessibility-focused nonprofit sets this up for elderly or disabled clients so they can manage their home entirely through natural-language chat.

money_ideas.idea: One-off installation and configuration fee for existing Home Assistant users
Ongoing 'AI home assistant' maintenance and support subscription

steal_this: Offer a flat-fee 'AI-ify your smart home' setup service this weekend for Home Assistant users you already know, wiring up ha-mcp plus a few starter automations.
